limitations: Candidate handle/path associations do not prove file identity or kernel object identity.
Path representation labels are descriptive pattern matches, not validity checks.
The audit processes the fixed 20-report Phase 0C sample, not the full dataset.
Additional path/handle APIs are reported observationally and are not classified as modifying APIs.

methodology.additional_api_rule: include any call with a path-like or handle-like argument name
methodology.handle_grouping: strip and lowercase only for candidate keys

missing_rules.unusable: present but non-string/non-scalar after unwrapping value

methodology.ordering: stored process-call position only; timestamps never used to order
